title: I Need To Go Alone
question: 把今天“礼貌请求 -> 清楚边界 -> 不撒谎也不伤人”的表达，放进 school library 场景：用 word bank 补完整 5 个空。
example_answer: I am busy finishing my project in the library. My classmate asks, 'Would you mind my coming with you?' I say, 'I'm sorry, I need to work alone today.' He still wants to come because he has nothing to do. I answer kindly, 'Maybe another time. Please don't follow me around all morning.'

options.label: A
options.scenario_zh: 说明自己正在忙一件具体的事
options.english_template: I am busy ___ in the library.

options.label: C
options.scenario_zh: 清楚说明今天需要一个人完成

options.label: E
options.scenario_zh: 礼貌但明确地阻止对方一直跟着
